notes: From legacy/Custom builds/Little Minions - Disciple of Varashta.md: Disciple of Varashta, exactly two combat buttons, every Skeleton, Companion, Wolf, Spectre and Wardbound Minions banned, Chaos Inoculation, pure Energy Shield above 4,500, Fire/Cold/Lightning 75% (CI covers Chaos). Main skill Kelari's Deception, as the doc has it (the manager, 12 Nov: in the current game data, ActiveSkills id djinn_explosive_teleport, a Command skill of Kelari, the Tainted Sands; SEARCH1's note that it was gone was wrong). Budget 150 divines (the user, 12 Nov: 'I usually say around 100-200div'). Its disabled weapon-set exploit was removed in 0.5.5.
waits_for: the djinn Command model (MECH lane): PoB has Kelari's Deception only as a minion skill (Data/Skills/minion.lua), so the tool can't use it as a main skill yet. Left out of runs until then; gate_user.py --include-waiting runs it.
